title: Gino amri sadah yan agat
intro: Rakaakayal aydaadi dabaanitteh addat qagaaqagitak geytima, ayyunti saytun madqooqil fakut tan uluulukat mannoowak suge. Ken abtoota tumbulleh amixxige waytaamih taagah inkih tan seehadayti baxi maabitina akkuk kassitan. too roocitte miyyak sugteeh, ma sarrimaane keenil raddeeh?
clues: Nanu elle sugne baaxol safar mari mango uddur elle taturta gita, takkay immay nanu ken safar qawwalayla abne.
Nanu too abtoota abneh baadal num ahak dumal abe weem.
Ni fanak farmoyti ninni gita cabnuh nee seeceeh, laakin nanu kaa cinneh, usug numma yaabe kaa tekkek digaala essere.
Qaxmeqe qibina ni magaala fan temeete wak, nanu ken maysattaka gorrisne, oson finqah farmoytit kinnim aaxige kal.
Nanu soolise waynek bohoy le digaalak takkaawisneh sugne, takkay immay takkaawissot tusuuleh ninni zambih addat raqne.
Qaranak xaahi rob nee radeeh, ni buxaaxi qanxixxeh, celsiisenta wagsiisak asta dubuk raqteh.

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
